rules.title: Shared Surface Ownership
rules.description: Shared backgrounds, borders, typography, focus and control padding have registered stylesheet owners. A new selector or owner is rejected until the registry and this description are reviewed together.

rules.title: Exact Legacy Exceptions
rules.description: Legacy CSS is not exempt by filename. Existing regulated declarations, priorities and nested conditions are frozen individually. Additions, edits and removals require an explicit list/description update; migrated pages cannot regain an undocumented local skin.

rules.title: Native Controls
rules.description: New static fields, commands and binary preferences use the listed shared components. Existing nonstandard native controls are exact exceptions; new unclassified controls fail without an explicitly described exception.

rules.title: Runtime Factories
rules.description: DOM, markup, class and style factories are parsed with Acorn and registered by normalized AST. A changed or new factory needs explicit registry and description review, even if the change is likely compliant. Formatting and comments do not require a signature update.

rules.title: Theme And Composition
rules.description: Colors and shared control values belong to theme owners. Page composition may use existing tokens for layout. Existing style lint additionally rejects hardcoded colors, local shared-token overrides and undocumented component duplication.

rules.title: Stylesheet Dependencies
rules.description: Root pages load theme.css, site.css and pages.css once in that order. Nonstandard links and CSS imports are individually registered; direct shared-layer or external stylesheet additions cannot silently bypass ownership.

rules.title: Inline Styles And Content
rules.description: HTML inline styles and inline style blocks are not a new authoring path. Dynamic style sinks require factory review. Existing non-empty data CSS strings are frozen under the swatch migration backlog; arbitrary new strings need a described exception.

rules.title: Documentation Coupling
rules.description: This complete rule list, ownership list and exception description is generated deterministically from the versioned JSON registry. Missing descriptions, stale prose, duplicate entries and count mismatches fail. Inventory collection never accepts source changes into the policy.

rules.title: Required Verification
rules.description: The exact-tree pre-commit/pre-push material gate and CI require this contract, existing style checks and required component references. Runtime, accessibility and reviewed visual checks remain mandatory for affected features; no automatic visual approval is introduced.

rules.title: Policy Changes And Limits
rules.description: Changing these rules is policy maintenance and requires an explained registry/documentation diff plus independent review. Repository checks cannot stop an administrator who edits the checks or bypasses protections; GitHub required checks and code-owner review must be configured separately.
